title: Paper Relations
description: Stage-4 typed paper-to-paper edges anchored at one focal paper. Output of the relations producer in the single-paper deep-read path. Each edge names how the focal paper relates to another paper (inherits / refutes / unifies / replaces / opens / extends / uses), so the read paper can be situated in its lineage rather than read in isolation.

source_ref.description: the focal paper this relation map is anchored at — every edge is read FROM this paper

edges.description: typed directed edges from the focal paper to other papers

target_ref.description: the other paper this edge points to

relation.description: how the focal paper relates to the target paper

note.description: free-text justification for this edge — what exactly is inherited/refuted/etc.
